name: Engenty Copilot
description: Core Engenty copilot full-page chat and apps/ai UI consumer

vars.description: Vercel AI Gateway API key — required for the copilot (apps/ai). Create at https://vercel.com/d?to=/[team]/~/ai/api-keys

instructions: 1. Open the Vercel dashboard → AI Gateway → API keys
2. Create a key and copy it

vars.description: OpenRouter API key — optional second model gateway. Set it to bind roles to OpenRouter models in Settings → AI models; Vercel-bound roles keep using AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY.

instructions: 2. Create a key and copy it

vars.description: Default model routed through the AI Gateway (e.g. openai/gpt-5.6-luna).
Enable apps/ai to refresh the Gateway model catalog from Vercel AI Gateway on a schedule.
Run Gateway model catalog sync when apps/ai starts (populates copilot model dropdowns after fresh setup).
Opper API key — a third model gateway (OpenAI-compatible, EU-hosted). Chat models only; its catalog is listed once the key is set.

instructions: 2. Create a key and copy it

vars.description: OpenAI API key — reaches OpenAI directly as a model gateway (chat models) and powers realtime voice.

instructions: Create a key under API keys in the OpenAI platform.

vars.description: Anthropic API key — reaches Anthropic directly as a model gateway (chat models).

instructions: Create a key under API keys in the Anthropic console.

vars.description: Mistral API key — enables the Voxtral speech-to-text leg of the Voxtral+ElevenLabs realtime voice cascade. Without it the cascade provider is not registered and tenants selecting it get HTTP 501.

instructions: Create a key under API Keys in the Mistral console.

vars.description: ElevenLabs API key — enables the text-to-speech leg of the Voxtral+ElevenLabs realtime voice cascade (Austrian/Bavarian dialect voices). Required together with MISTRAL_API_KEY. The key must include voices_read and text_to_speech permissions.

instructions: Create a key under Profile → API Keys in the ElevenLabs app.
Enable at least voices_read and text_to_speech (restricted keys without voices_read cannot populate the voice dropdown).

vars.description: Set to false to disable Mastra thread and shared observational memory for agent chat. Enabled by default.
Set to true to enable Mastra thread-scoped semantic recall (embeds every saved chat turn and queries pgvector on each turn). Off by default. Requires AI Gateway embeddings and a Postgres vector URL.
Time budget for ONE model call in an agent run, in milliseconds. Default 180000 (3 min); a call past it fails the run with a named timeout instead of hanging. 0 disables.

Hard override for the recalled-history token budget of every agent, in tokens. Unset: derived per run from the model's catalog context window minus the tool block, the reply reserve and the runtime tail (100000 when the window is unknown).
Time budget for a WHOLE agent run (every step, tool call and retry), in milliseconds. Default 1200000 (20 min). 0 disables.
Langfuse secret key. Sends every agent run (model steps, tool calls, prompts and completions) to Langfuse; off when unset.

instructions: Project settings → API keys in Langfuse.

vars.description: Langfuse public key.

instructions: Project settings → API keys in Langfuse.

vars.description: Langfuse base URL (cloud region or self-hosted instance).
OTLP traces endpoint (http/protobuf). Any OpenTelemetry backend — Phoenix, Jaeger, Grafana, Honeycomb, Braintrust — receives the same agent-run spans as Langfuse; off when unset.

instructions: The /v1/traces URL of your collector or vendor.

vars.description: Headers sent with every OTLP export, as key=value pairs separated by commas (vendor API keys go here).
Persist agent-run traces in the Mastra store (ai.mastra_ai_spans) so Mastra Studio's Traces view can show them. Grows without a retention sweep — keep off in production for now.

Wire-level LLM call trace: one JSON file per model call (request as the provider receives it, response, byte accounting per tool schema). `1` writes under <cwd>/.llm-trace; a path writes there. Holds conversation data — never commit it.
